description: Semantic (embedding-based) search over the p05 collection of Xianmi Library (xianmi.co): ~1.8k modern Chinese vernacular translations (白话译文) of Buddhist scriptures, Simplified Chinese. Best for natural-language conceptual queries (e.g. "如何消除烦恼", "因果报应的道理"); for exact-quote or full-library keyword search use search_texts instead. Returns matched passages with relevance scores, page URLs and get_passage hints. Attribution required: see the license pointer included in every response.

query.description: Natural-language query (Chinese recommended), e.g. "如何消除烦恼"

name: semantic_search
title: Semantic search over the p05 modern Chinese translation collection
